messages:
sara_cs: Customer reports promo code NEWUSER50 shows \"Accepted\" in the UI but the account balance remains $0.00. Account: acct_9X2... Email: jane@acme.com. She redeemed yesterday around 15:20 PST and attached a screenshot.

michael_billing: Can you paste the exact redeem id / any webhook IDs from the UI logs so I can check the ledger?

sara_cs: Redeem id from UI: redeem_20260318_834. From web logs I see: promo_webhook event -> status=accepted code=NEWUSER50 user=acct_9X2 request_id=req_7f3b. No obvious error in the UI flow.

support-bot: Note: grant created grant_922 for acct_9X2 amount=50.00 USD expires=2026-04-17. Apply job scheduled.

alex_engineer: Quick check on apply job logs: the apply worker called billing-ledger-service at 2026-04-18T23:18:45Z and got 502. Handler logged response: {"applied": false, "reason": "no_account_balance_entry_found"} The job didn't requeue due to current error branch.

michael_billing: I queried the billing DB: grant row exists (grant_922) but there is no corresponding ledger transaction. The ledger-service returned 502, looks like a transient upstream error. I'll open a finance ops ticket and request a manual ledger entry.

michael_billing: Created FIN-2026-1798 and pinged @finance_team. Action: manual credit + mark grant as applied. Also adding a note to investigate job retry semantics.

finance_team: Acknowledged. We'll post manual txn and confirm here. ETA ~1-2 hours.

sara_cs: Told customer we're investigating and gave an ETA. They asked whether the promo code was consumed — yes it shows consumed on our side; it's just the balance entry missing.

alex_engineer: Found root cause: apply worker treats 5xx from ledger as success path (missing requeue). I'll push a small fix to requeue on 5xx/network errors and add a metric for apply_failures_5xx.

michael_billing: Patch landed to staging. Will promote after finance confirms manual fix. Also added a temporary dashboard to track grant apply 5xx > 0.5%.

finance_team: Manual transaction posted txn_5543 (+$50) and grant_922 marked applied. Balance for acct_9X2 is now $50. Receipt emailed to jane@acme.com.

sara_cs: Replied to customer with steps to refresh and check the balance in the Console. Asked them to confirm once they see it.

sara_cs: Customer confirmed they now see $50 in their Console and can start using credits. Closing the loop. :tada:

michael_billing: Follow-ups: PR #3426 to fix requeue logic; alert on grant-apply 5xx rate; update runbook for manual apply. Leaving FIN-2026-1798 with resolution notes.

alex_engineer: Adding unit/integration tests for the retry path, will include in PR.

sara_cs: Thanks everyone. Marking thread resolved.
